interface.shortDescription: Connect Nexts to the local GridCraft desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Read and edit spreadsheets, manage formulas and charts, and export workbooks through the local GridCraft desktop control channel. Requires GridCraft to be installed with control port 7982 enabled. The plugin checks that the desktop app and local bridge are reachable before editing, discovers available commands before execution, and keeps the project visible in the desktop application.
defaultPrompt: Open GridCraft and help me work on the current project.
Use GridCraft to create or edit a project and show the result.
